correct_source: Correct rows = the reporter's sql1 (same query with ON 1, ON condition is always true here), whose values are confirmed by the fix's test TestIssue40015: DATE_ADD(c1, INTERVAL 1 DAY_HOUR) over varchar values 101111 (=BIN(47)) and 11100 (=BIN(28)) must give '2010-11-11 01:00:00' and NULL respectively.
